name: kadaliao
description: Claude Code mods by kadaliao: function-hook plugins that change Claude Code's own interface and behaviour

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: A two-row status band: model, folder, git branch, context window, tokens, cache rate, API cost, tokens/s and TTFT

plugins.name: prompt-en
plugins.description: English under each prompt: a translation when you write in another language, corrections or other ways to say it when you write in English, and a vocabulary book to review them. Or the same in Japanese

plugins.name: danmaku
plugins.description: Bilibili-style bullet comments that fly across a few lanes above the prompt as Claude works: heckles about what it does, philosophers' lines that fit the moment, or philosophers heckling it, in Chinese, English or both

plugins.name: ambience
plugins.description: Sounds for what Claude does (commands, edits, tests, commits, a finished turn), a notification after a long turn, and a live tally of the turn's work under the prompt

plugins.name: peek
plugins.description: See the pictures Claude looks at: a thumbnail under each Read or screenshot in the conversation and under each pasted picture, large under ctrl+o, drawn with the terminal's own pictures
